summary: Elkins-Randolph County Regional Airport (EKN) is a public-use airport serving Elkins and the surrounding Randolph County in the mountainous heart of West Virginia. Situated at an elevation of around 1,987 feet, it provides vital air access to the central highlands region, supporting general aviation, charter operations, and tourism to nearby Monongahela National Forest and ski resorts. The airport also serves Davis & Elkins College and the broader Pocahontas-Randolph recreational corridor.
faqs:
Q: Where is Elkins-Randolph County Regional Airport located?
A: The airport is situated approximately three miles south of downtown Elkins in Randolph County, West Virginia, within the Appalachian highlands.

Q: Does the airport offer commercial airline service?
A: EKN primarily handles general aviation and charter flights; commercial scheduled service is limited or nonexistent, so most visitors fly into larger hubs like Charleston or Pittsburgh and drive or arrange connecting flights.

Q: What facilities are available at the airport?
A: The airport features a single runway, a terminal building, fuel services, tie-downs, hangar space, and basic amenities for general aviation pilots and passengers.

Q: Can I rent a car at the airport?
A: Car rental availability is limited, so arranging transportation in advance with local agencies, hotels, or shuttle services is recommended.
transport_tips: Rental car options at EKN are limited, so travelers should arrange ground transportation ahead of time, including taxi services or pre-booked shuttles. The airport is a short drive from downtown Elkins via US Routes 33 and 219, and parking is generally convenient on-site. If you need broader flight connections, consider flying into larger airports like North Central West Virginia (CKB) or Pittsburgh International and driving in.
local_tip: Time your visit to catch the Mountain State Forest Festival in early fall, when Elkins hosts one of West Virginia's largest celebrations featuring crafts, parades, and Appalachian heritage events right near the airport.
